0.0: Ah, it's you! You were a huge help to the Eliminate Teddies campaign! That seems like so long ago... These days, I'm heading the #bSharing Toys#k campaign! Ah, you look very interested. Want to participate?

yes.0: Good, good. This campaign is about #eSharing Toys#n. Just like the name! As you know, Ludibrium is a world of toys. But that's not the case for other areas. Not all kids have the luxury of owning toys like we do.
yes.1: That is exactly why I want to gather up the toys of Ludibrium and share them with kids of the world! Or, rather, I want you to gather the toys up for me. Can you collect #b60#k #i4000109##b#t4000109##k items from #r#o3210204##k?
